recipes.name: One-Bowl Nut Butter & Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C)*.
Mash the bananas in a large bowl. Then mix together with the peanut butter until smooth.
Add the remaining ingredients, and mix.
Roll the dough into balls and place on the baking tray. Press to form each ball into a cookie shape, as the cookies don't spread in the oven. Press some more chocolate decoratively on top if desired.
Bake on the middle rack of the oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or until golden.
Allow the cookies to cool on the tray slightly before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † If you don’t have quick oats, pulse regular rolled oats in a blender or food processor until coarsely chopped. † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days. Store in the freezer for up to 2 months (great to enjoy for an on-the-go snack)!
